Joe Root Breaks Sachin Tendulkar Record in ODI

England cricketer Joe Root has surpassed another record previously held by Sachin Tendulkar. Root achieved this milestone during the first One Day International (ODI) match against Sri Lanka, which took place in Durham. He became the second-fastest batter to reach 23,000 international runs.
